author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 나무 위에서 생활하는 새로, 낙엽활엽수림과 혼효림에 둥지를 튼다. 먹이를 숨겨 두는 습성이 있고, 날 때는 천천히 날갯짓하며 날아오른 뒤 대개 물결 모양을 그린다. 경계할 때는 요란하게 울며 다른 동물의 소리를 흉내 내기도 한다. 4~6월에 알 5~6개를 낳으며, 북위 40~60°의 유럽과 아시아에 분포한다.

art.subject: Eurasian Jay (Garrulus glandarius), adult of the Korean population (sexes alike, plumage the same all year): forehead, crown, nape and face plain rufous-cinnamon, with only a few fine dark streaks on the forehead just above the bill; no crest, the crown feathers lie flat and the head is smoothly rounded; throat whitish; broad black moustachial stripe from the bill base down the side of the throat; mantle and back plain grey, contrasting with the rufous head; breast and flanks greyish pinkish-brown, the belly paler and greyer; wing coverts at the bend of the wing finely barred bright blue, black and white; a white patch on the inner flight feathers; rest of the wing black; white rump, vent and undertail coverts; black tail; stout black bill; dark brown eye; pale pinkish-brown legs.
art.pose: perched on a branch holding an acorn in its bill
art.scene: Korean deciduous broadleaf and mixed forest in spring; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a branch: smooth rounded rufous head with no crest and only fine streaks on the forehead, dark eye, broad black moustachial stripe, grey back contrasting with the rufous head, greyish pinkish-brown underparts, blue-black-and-white barred patch at the bend of the wing, white patch on the inner wing, black tail

adult in flight seen from above, head, body and tail in line: rufous head, grey back, rounded black wings with the blue barred patch and the white patch, bright white rump contrasting with the black tail
art.build: Medium-sized, stocky member of the crow family, about 33cm: about the length of a feral pigeon, with a much shorter tail than a magpie. Large, smoothly rounded head with no crest, the crown flat, and a thick neck. Bill stout, black, shorter than the head, slightly arched. Legs medium length, pale pinkish-brown. Wings broad and rounded; at rest they reach about the base of the tail. Tail medium length, square to slightly rounded, black. Flight rather slow, with floppy wingbeats and undulating sweeps, flashing the white rump and the white wing patch.
avoid: Do not paint a whitish crown spotted or streaked black, a pale eye or a pinkish back; those belong to European jays. Korean birds have a plain rufous head, a dark eye and a grey back.
Do not paint a crest or spiky raised crown feathers; the crown lies flat and smooth.
Do not paint a blue body like American jays; only a small patch on the wing is blue.
Do not paint a black cap with plain blue wings and tail; that is Azure-winged Magpie.
Do not put the white wing patch on the outer primaries; it lies on the inner wing beside the blue patch.
